verdict.rationale:
Factory's tiered autonomy in droid exec implies some operations require manual confirmation before running, and Missions offer 'plan and execute' orchestration, suggesting a planning phase exists, but there is no explicit documentation of a discrete implementation-plan artifact that a developer reviews and approves before any code changes are made — the described workflow (docs-1) instead centers on reviewing the diff/output after changes.

missing for 10: explicit plan-approval UI/step description, evidence of a pre-execution plan artifact, confirmation that no code is touched until plan is approved.
